versions.changelog: Fixed water shattering at low zoom, where simplification had fattened narrow streams into slivers far wider than the real watercourse, and rebuilt land use alongside so the layers stay aligned.
Corrected the English romanization of city and neighborhood names using authoritative reading data; moved per-trip driving routes to a companion file for a lighter download.
Reworked commuter-to-workplace matching to reproduce census commute totals exactly; recomputed map geometry in the map's local projection for accurate shapes and a lighter download.
Rebuilt the Nagoya map onto the full current modeling pipeline — foundation depth, 3D building heights, fuller land use, and military demand.
Switched to Overture building data and stitched buildings and water into tiles for lighter rendering.
Initial release of the Nagoya map with census-based residents and workers, commute demand, and a full range of special-demand points.
